title: Construction.
officialText:
Material hoists, bucket hoists and their components shall be constructed in compliance with the manu-
facturing specifications, the requirements of this code, and rules promulgated by the commissioner. If there is a discrepancy, the
stricter requirement shall be met.
Upon completion of the installation of the hoisting equipment and/or its runback structure, an inspection report verifying that the
hoist has been installed in accordance with the design drawings, construction documents and specifications shall be prepared by the
designer, installer or an approved inspection agency designated by both the designer and installer.
